chunks: Until when the way is opened up for Gog and Magog and they press from every elevated place,
ai.seo_question: Who are Gog and Magog and when do they emerge according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the release of Ya'juj and Ma'juj as a distinct eschatological event preceding the final trumpet blast, often linked to the emergence of the Mahdi (aj). The phrase 'from every high place' (min kulli hadab) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to signify their rapid, overwhelming dispersal from all accessible elevations, marking a period of widespread corruption and tribulation for humanity.
